Comment: Per-run inline policy for the ubuntu-ami sample's BUILD-HOST instance role. setup.sh renders @STAGE_BUCKET@ and @RUN_ID@, puts it on this run's build role (<RESOURCE_PREFIX>-<RUN_ID>-build) as <RESOURCE_PREFIX>-<RUN_ID>-stage-read right before the build host downloads its staged files, and deletes it again once the build host has verified them (scripts/00b-stage-bucket.sh revoke confirms the policy and the objects are gone, and fails otherwise). It is the build host's only permission besides the AWS-managed AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy (SSM Session Manager and Run Command, no inbound rule): read this run's objects in this run's staging bucket, nothing else. s3:ListBucket is limited to the run's own prefix; AWS-RunRemoteScript, the Systems Manager document that downloads the objects with the instance profile, needs it beside s3:GetObject. The build host creates no AWS resources; setup.sh does that from the operator's credentials.
